name: SurvIQ
summary: Survey and form builder with cross-tab analysis, AI to write surveys and summarise answers, and a free plan; also has a thesis mode and 360 feedback.
best_for: freelancers, consultants, small teams and students who want a survey builder with built-in cross-tab analysis and AI summaries without paying for every feature separately
skip_if: you need more than 5,000 responses a month on a self-serve plan, or you want a tool we have tested on a paid plan
honest_knock: The free plan allows only 50 responses a month and 3 active surveys, and the page shows 33% introductory discounts that end after 3 months. Business shows Contact sales, and in our test on 18 November 2026 the app marked it Coming soon.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · 1,000 responses a month and 1 user
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on surviqapp.com/en, US dollars, and in our own test that day; earlier: read 2026-11-10) SurvIQ has a Free plan with 50 responses a month, 1 user and up to 3 active surveys. The page lists 10 question types on Free; in our test the Free editor offered 19. Basic costs $9 a month ($7 a month billed yearly) for 1,000 responses and 1 user, Pro costs $29 a month ($23 billed yearly) for 5,000 responses and 3 users, and Business costs $79 a month ($63 billed yearly) for 25,000 responses and 10 users. The yearly figures are what the page shows behind its Annual toggle ('2 months free'). Business carries a Contact sales button rather than a checkout, and in our test on 18 November 2026 the app marked it Coming soon. Until 31 December the page shows 33% off the monthly plans for the first 3 months ($6.03, $19.43 and $52.93), applied at checkout with no code; those are introductory prices, so plan on the full monthly price after that. If you do not want a subscription, prepaid credits run from $5 for 100 responses to $79 for 5,000 responses and never expire, and you can buy a tier once: Basic for $45 or Pro for $145, each with a monthly response quota. A Thesis Pass costs US$19, shown at US$9.50 until 31 December, for 12 months and one project. The page says you can try Pro free for 7 days. We did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session tested SurvIQ in our existing free account: the AI made 8 usable survey questions after one click, about 34 seconds from the start. The preview does not save answers, so the survey was published and filled in 3 times by the tester through its own link (not shared) and deleted afterwards. The AI summary has the numbers right (3.7/5, NPS 33) but gives a sentiment of Negative 100%. The follow up question for scores below 3 is an ordinary text question that every respondent sees, because logic starts on Basic. Powered by SurvIQ shows on Free, the Free export is CSV only, and Filter, Compare by and Advanced AI are locked. The prices match the dossier; annual prices and Business on Coming soon are new. The limit of 50 answers and the credits were not tested. No plan was bought. Account and start: the test used the existing SurvIQ our account, on the Free plan, with the interface in English. The test started at 09:08 in our own tab on the dashboard, which showed 0 of 50 monthly answers and AI: 0 of 5 uses. The product tour and the cookie banner were closed. The dossier name is SurvIQ and the review is on OSM (surviq); the handson folder name and the review slug are the same. Core action: Create with AI was used with a prompt for a made-up coffee event (Bean Fest Test Edition), 8 questions, a recommendation question and a follow up question if the score is below 3, at the Standard level (1 plan action or 1 credit); the Advanced level is locked with the text Available from the Basic plan. One click after the prompt the editor showed The AI added 8 questions. Review and adjust them before publishing. That was about 34 seconds after the start of the test (09:08:49 to 09:09:23). The 8 questions (rating, multiple choice, single choice, two ratings, long text, NPS and yes/no/maybe) were usable and in a logical order, with a 0 to 10 NPS question. A condition that cannot work on Free: the follow up question for scores below 3 (question 6) is an ordinary long text question that every respondent sees (If you rated your experience below 3, please tell us what we could do to improve.). Real logic is locked behind LOGIC: Available from the Basic plan, so the AI wrote a condition into the text that a Free user cannot make work. Collecting answers: the preview says Preview mode: responses are not saved, so the survey had to be published (Your survey is live!) to get results. The link was not shared; it was opened only by the tester in its own tab. The public page and the thank-you screen both show Powered by SurvIQ on Free (whether the branding can be removed on paid plans was not tested). The survey was filled in 3 times with made-up answers (scores 4, 2 and 5; NPS 9, 4 and 10; made-up text). Results: 3 responses, 100% completion rate, an average time of 18 seconds, a funnel of 3, 3 and 3 and a chart per question. The block Where people drop off is locked for Pro. The AI summary (Summarize, Standard) got the numbers right: an average event rating of 3.7/5, an NPS of 33, the coffee at 4.3/5 and 67% for the tasting process. The weak part is the sentiment bar: it says Negative 100% and Positive 0%, because the survey itself asks for improvement points, while the scores and the summary text are mostly positive; the theme Event Logistics and Operations got 3 recommendations. Ask and Categorize were not used. Free limits seen: Filter needs Basic, Compare by needs Pro, Variables needs Basic, Margin of error needs Basic, Significant difference needs Pro and Email report starts from Pro; Advanced AI is locked. The export on Free has only CSV (Raw data only) open; PDF, PowerPoint, Excel, Analysis Excel, SPSS (.sav) and R (.zip) are locked; nothing was downloaded. After the test the counter said 3 / 50, resets on December 1; the limit of 50 itself was not reached. Plans, read up to the payment step: monthly Free $0 (50 monthly answers, 1 user, up to 3 active surveys, 10 question types, CSV export, simple analytics), Basic $9 (1.000 answers, 1 user, unlimited surveys, conditional logic), Pro $29 (5.000 answers, 3 users, 200 AI actions a month) and Business $79 (25.000 answers, 10 users, 600 AI actions a month, 360 feedback), with 33% off the first 3 months until 31 December (Basic $6.03, Pro $19.43, Business $52.93). Annual prices (switch Annual, 2 months free): Basic $7, Pro $23 and Business $63 a month. One-off PERMANENT UNLOCK: Basic $45 (75 answers a month, 300 bonus credits) and Pro $145 (200 answers a month, 1000 bonus credits); a Thesis Pass at US$19 (US$9.50 with the 50% offer); credit packs Starter $5 for 100, Growth $15 for 500, Pro $35 for 1,500 and Scale $79 for 5,000. Basic and Pro have a Start 7-day free trial button, which was not clicked. Nothing was filled in and no card was entered. Deviations from the dossier: the monthly prices, the 33% offer until 31 December, the credits from $5 for 100 and the one-off $45 and $145 match the dossier. New against the dossier: (a) annual prices of $7, $23 and $63 a month are now visible (the dossier said they were not); (b) the Business plan has a Coming soon button, so it cannot be bought now; (c) Free says 10 question types while the editor menu showed 19 types. No price field is changed here. Checkout: NOT reached. No plan, trial, credit pack or pass was bought or started, so no tax, total or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: Free has no subscription. Settings has Delete account (permanently deletes the account and all data), which was not used. Not tested: conditional logic (Basic), Filter and Compare by (paid), the limit of 50 monthly answers, buying credits and whether they never expire, a CSV download, the PDF report, Ask and Categorize, sharing by email, WhatsApp or QR, SMTP, Thesis, Leads and Advanced AI. Clean up: the test survey Bean Fest Test Edition Feedback with its 3 test answers was deleted from the card menu and the list showed 0 surveys; the first tab hung on the confirmation box and was closed, and the deletion was finished in a second own tab of the tester; both tabs were closed. The account stays on Free. The AI used 2 plan actions (the survey and the summary). Nothing was mailed, shared, paid or connected.
exit_test.awkward: The AI writes the below 3 follow up question as plain text that everybody sees, because real logic starts on Basic. The preview does not save answers, so you have to publish a survey to see results. The AI summary says Negative 100% sentiment next to a 3.7/5 average. Powered by SurvIQ shows on Free. The Free export is CSV only. The Business plan is on Coming soon.
